reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes PlusToken and AI-Dog as a way to get paid for holding and compounding tokens, while directing viewers through the participation steps. The speaker demonstrates exchanging PlusToken for ETH and adding the ETH to AI-Dog, where the interface confirms the amount as opened or activated, presenting the scheme as an actionable earning process rather than analyzing or warning about it.

citations.quote: To learn more about how to get paid to HODL
Then, exchange your Plustoken into Eth.
I just add up whatever I want to add up into my AI Dock for the ethereum I just convert from Plus Token
How To Compound PlusToken

opening.argument: Judge, the description says viewers can learn about getting paid to hold, but it does not specify a rate, promise a guaranteed return, or show anyone receiving a payout. The spoken walkthrough ends with an ETH amount described as activated, not withdrawn earnings. Treat that distinction seriously: a demonstrated account balance is not proof that the speaker is promising a profitable outcome.

citations.quote: To learn more about how to get paid to HODL
I now have 2.6616 Ethereum activated in my AI doc

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening relies on the phrase about getting paid, then treats conversion and activation as an earning process. But its cited steps establish only that the speaker exchanges tokens and adds ETH to an account. Even the speaker's description of the result is an activated amount, not a return or withdrawal.

citations.quote: Then, exchange your Plustoken into Eth.
I now have 2.6616 Ethereum activated in my AI doc

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A completed payout is not necessary to understand what the video promotes. The description explicitly offers to teach viewers how to get paid for holding and directs them to a PlusToken training site. The walkthrough then shows how to put converted ETH into the account. The absence of a specified rate or completed withdrawal does not erase that invitation to participate.

citations.quote: To learn more about how to get paid to HODL, go to our PlusToken Training Website: http://plustoken.training/team.
I just add up whatever I want to add up into my AI Dock for the ethereum I just convert from Plus Token

opening.argument: Judge, the speaker states the immediate purpose as showing how to exchange a token and add ETH, then narrates their own wallet actions step by step. They refer to their existing ETH amount and show where to inspect the account's transactions. That is substantial evidence of an operational demonstration. The description's broader invitation should not make every step in the video a claim that the viewer will earn money.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The cited title and walkthrough support an instructional reading: they identify a compounding topic and demonstrate interface steps. Calling the displayed amount an actionable earning process adds an inference the screen itself cannot establish. The description is promotional, but the opening has not shown a return being earned during the demonstration.

citations.quote: How To Compound PlusToken
To learn more about how to get paid to HODL

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The instructional format is precisely what makes the promotion actionable. The description connects the tutorial to getting paid for holding and sends viewers to a training site; the speaker then tells them which exchange and account steps to take. Demonstrating those steps does not make the earning pitch incidental.

citations.quote: To learn more about how to get paid to HODL, go to our PlusToken Training Website: http://plustoken.training/team.
you need to go on your Plustoken wallet and you click exchange. Then, exchange your Plustoken into Eth.

opening.argument: Judge, the concrete activity shown is use of an existing wallet: exchanging a token for ETH, entering a transaction password in the app, and checking the resulting account record. The speaker does not tell viewers to disclose that password to them. The cited material also does not establish a required outside payment, a recruited downline, or a guaranteed yield. A promotional link to training is not, by itself, evidence of those missing mechanisms.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The reference opening identifies conversion and ETH activation, but those actions alone do not establish a demand for credentials, an external deposit, or a guaranteed return. The description supplies an earning-oriented pitch; it does not fill in those missing mechanics. Judge the observed operations without assuming an unshown outcome.

To learn more about how to get paid to HODL

true_side_reply.rebuttal: This is more than a generic wallet exchange. The description pitches getting paid for holding, while the speaker instructs viewers to convert PlusToken and add the resulting ETH to AI Dock. A request to surrender credentials, a downline, or proof of a withdrawal is not needed to see the promoted participation path.
